NEWS9 Live
2220000 subscribers
6 likes

9 Jan 2025
Congress is fighting for relevance in Delhi after dismal performances in the last two assembly elections. This time, the party has centred its pitch on Sheila Dikshit’s legacy, emphasizing her transformative 15-year tenure as the architect of modern Delhi. Banking on her reputation for development, Congress is contrasting her achievements with AAP’s perceived lack of infrastructure progress, aiming to reconnect with voters and reclaim its lost ground. On-point decodes with an expert panel.
